summary.en: A big word springs in letter by letter and its weight swings 780 → 200 → 800 → 430 on the beats; its full stop is the line colour.
summary.zh: 大字逐字弹入，字重在拍点上 780 → 200 → 800 → 430 摆动；句号是线色。

fits: A one-word hook in a variable display face.
notFor: Faces without a weight axis; long words or sentences.

intent.en: Make the beat visible in a word that stays in place and keeps reading.
intent.zh: 让节拍体现在一个原地不动、始终可读的词上。

notFor.zh: 没有字重轴的字体；长词或整句。

en: Centre by the width at the current weight, or the word slides sideways as it swings.
zh: 按当前字重的宽度居中，否则摆动时整个词会左右滑。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
